**Finding: deviation (Section 2.1)**

Section 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination rights — the playbook's walk-away scenario. It also conflicts with Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment) and hollows out our termination and refund rights under Sections 9 and 10.2.

Redline (validated, preferred level): replace the commitment with "Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or volume commitment. Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term." The comment offers the fallback of a 12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a penalty, if a commitment is commercially essential.
